title: longfellow-vectors mdoc credential vector, v1
description: Sidecar for a CBOR credential under vectors/mdoc/credentials/.

doctype.description: DocType read from the credential. Present only when the CBOR parsed as a DeviceResponse at write time.

device_key.description: Vector name of the credential's device key. Present only when the key vector's public half matched the credential's deviceKeyInfo at write time.

ds_certificate.description: Vector name of the credential's document-signer certificate. Present only when the certificate's bytes matched the credential's x5chain leaf at write time.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the sibling .cbor file's bytes.
